# velin-tooltip

Tooltip on hover/focus (bridges to `<velin-tooltip>`).

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty) | Use host `title` / text as tooltip | `<velin-tooltip>` |
| `text` | Explicit tooltip label | `<velin-tooltip>` |
## Example

```html
<div velin-tooltip>…</div>
```
